The model by jimsbeanz is great, but I wanted a more distinct look for Epic because everyone assumes it's a Carnibug when printed at that scale, so I spent a bit of time remixing it to look more like the original.
I did not add eyeballs on purpose, the holes for eyes are more crisp and it's hard to tell anyways.
File is fully supported and scaled with all parts, just drag and drop.
Fits perfectly on a 25x40mm tank base, I might add one to the files later.
